title: Installing a Fiberglass Tub and Surround: Drain/Overflow, Valve Rough-In, and Finish

locations.name: Probable bathroom remodel site (interior, walls opened for plumbing and tub work)
locations.basis: Transcript notes walls are open for plumbing checks and tub install; no explicit shooting location is given.

summary: The video walks through a bathroom remodeling sequence to install a fiberglass tub and surround. It starts with establishing support (ledger board) and verifying plumbing access, then pre-assembling the drain and overflow and selecting a potential new shower valve. The tub is positioned, holes are drilled through the flange for the rough-in shower valve and tub spout, and the unit is secured to the studs. The installer explains creating a proper spout connection with copper adapters, patches the drain opening with a compatible cover, tightens the trap connections, and finishes with caulk, drywall touch-ups, and installing a shower curtain, culminating in a functional tub/shower surround.

sections.description: Introduces the fiberglass tub, notes its gel coat interior, and emphasizes preparing the drain and overflow outside the tub before setting it in place, while acknowledging open walls allow plumbing checks.

sections.title: Pre-assembly of drain hardware and initial fit
sections.description: Shows mounting the drain/overflow assembly, connecting the trip lever and stopper linkage, and confirming the hardware aligns correctly as the tub is prepared for installation.

sections.title: Securing tub to studs and rough-in considerations
concepts: drilling through tub flange into studs
sections.description: Covers lifting and positioning the tub, drilling holes through the flange to reach studs, and beginning to secure the tub; discusses creating a solid in-wall path for the tub spout and rough-in.

sections.title: Patch fitting, trap connection, and final finish
sections.description: Completes the rough-in with a drain-cover patch, tightens the trap connections, performs drywall finishing and caulking, and installs the shower curtain for a finished look.
